purpose: Seed a local engineering model with validated Maxxed orchestration, scheduling, repair, routing, product-factory, and operator behaviors.
authoritative_state_policy: The model is advisory. Deterministic control-plane state, leases, fencing, liveness, admission, and acceptance gates remain authoritative.
domain_policy: Each dataset below is tagged with exactly one of the domains above and must not mix examples across domains within a single file. This control plane is the canonical owner of model training going forward; other systems (e.g. email-marketing's llm_control.training_examples) may be imported as a *source* for a domain's corpus but do not remain the architectural owner of that data once imported.

record_schema.domain: string (one of `domains` above; required for datasets added after 2026-09-14)

datasets.note: Original seed corpus; domain assigned retroactively for the 7-domain taxonomy. Spans control-plane/scheduler/repair decisions, closest single fit is orchestration-agent-planning.

Read-only import of email-marketing's legacy training_examples table. Labels are transport-accepted only, not quality-evidenced (see email-marketing's CANONICAL_TRAINING_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md) -- treat as raw corpus material pending the ported evaluation/promotion gates, not as promotion-eligible data.

provenance.validation_policy: 2/2 successful runs on Maxxed-Technical-Systems organization-scoped local self-hosted runner
